decisions.decision: What the generator does about Context7 after plan 1
decisions.ruling: The generator works without Context7. It never halts on it and never asks the user to install it. This reverses D9 of docs/memory/decisions/2026-11-02-optional-tools-in-vwf-tools.md and the interim D2 of plan 2026-11-09-retire-plugin-mcp-servers
decisions.rejected: Keep Context7 required and only ask the user; drop plan 2

decisions.decision: The order of the research sources
decisions.ruling: Context7 first when the user has installed it. Without it: WebFetch of the official documentation, WebSearch to find the right page, and the package registries for names and versions. Every fact keeps its citation (URL and fetch date), as today
decisions.rejected: The live page or the registry decides every fact, Context7 a first look only

decisions.decision: The 140 passive Context7 hints in 116 files of 48 packs (B124)
decisions.ruling: Each hint keeps the Context7 name and adds 'when Context7 is installed; else the official documentation'. Provenance citations of the form 'Context7 /<library>, read <date>' stay unchanged. This reverses D16 of the 2026-11-02 record
decisions.rejected: Reword with no tool named; delete the hints

decisions.decision: Pack versions
decisions.ruling: Each pack U2 edits gets a patch bump in its pack.yaml and a new pin in every bundle that pins it; the versions 13 and 17 are never issued as a component, so a bump that reaches one steps past it. U2 runs mise x -- mise run p:plugins:inventory as its last step
decisions.rejected: No bump

decisions.decision: One sweep unit
decisions.ruling: All pack edits sit in U2, because the pre-commit inventory hook needs the regenerated inventory in the same commit as each version bump, and two units cannot own inventory.md in one wave
decisions.rejected: Several pack units in parallel

decisions.decision: A review unit
decisions.ruling: None. No code that runs changes; the wave review is the only check
decisions.rejected: A security review unit

decisions.decision: Execution mode
decisions.ruling: teams, because wave 1 holds two edit units
decisions.rejected: solo

decisions.decision: Who formats the changed files
decisions.ruling: Before it returns, each edit unit (U1, U2, U3) runs mise x -- mise run code:format -- --fix <each file it changed>, on its own changed files only
decisions.rejected: A fixing unit gate

decisions.decision: The marketplace manifest
decisions.ruling: U1 changes the stackgen plugin.json description ('per-topic Context7 research' becomes per-topic research, with Context7 first when Context7 is installed) and runs mise x -- mise run p:plugins:marketplace as its last step, keeping the output in its commit
decisions.rejected: Leave the description

decisions.decision: Mechanical fixes from rulings round 1 (gaps 4 to 10)
decisions.ruling: Gap 4: the hint phrase is exactly when Context7 is installed, and K1 and the U2 check read whole sentences. Gap 5: K1 accepts history lines. Gaps 6 to 8: U3 owns .claude/skills/vwf-plugin/references/dependencies.md (93-101) and edits site vwf.md (4059), choosing-your-stack.md (202-203) and stackgen-plugin SKILL.md (301). Gap 9: U1 finds each passage by its quoted text, because plan 1 moves the line numbers. Gap 10: U1 and U2 format their own changed files (D8)
decisions.rejected: Ask each one; they follow from D1, D3 and D8

decisions.decision: No research source reachable at all (rulings round 1, gap 1)
decisions.ruling: The generator halts before writing anything, with one plain sentence: no research source is reachable (WebFetch, WebSearch and the registries refused or offline, and no Context7). A generated pack needs cited facts. The halt names no install step
decisions.rejected: Write the pack uncited and let the reviewer gate fail it

decisions.decision: Context7 fails in the middle of the run (rulings round 1, gap 2)
decisions.ruling: From the topic that failed on, the generator uses WebSearch, WebFetch and the registries for the rest of the run and does not try Context7 again. The research record names the topic where it switched
decisions.rejected: Retry Context7 per topic

decisions.decision: The thin-coverage rule (rulings round 1, gap 3)
decisions.ruling: Thin applies to the primary source of the run: Context7 when installed, else the official documentation. Other sources are used only for a thin topic, and the research record discloses each thin topic, as today. The registries are always read for package names and versions. U1 updates the thin-research checks of stackgen-skill-reviewer.md (about lines 45, 78 and 83) and generator.md to match
decisions.rejected: Drop the rule and always read every source

decisions.decision: Mechanical fixes from rulings round 2 (gaps 1-3, 6-12)
decisions.ruling: Gap 1: D13 wins; with Context7 installed the web sources serve thin topics only, and the registries are always read. Gaps 2 and 3: the reputation UNRESOLVED halt stays on its own terms; Edit 2 and generator.md (about line 37) drop only the Context7 comparison and its remedy. Gaps 6, 7, 8 and 11: K1 accepts the D11-D13 wording, provenance and past-evidence statements (unchanged by U2), the config_format 26 lines and history lines. Gap 9: each pack bump is computed once from the pack version on the base branch, so a retried U2 never bumps twice. Gaps 10 and 12: U3 owns .claude/docs/plugins.md (13), .claude/skills/vwf-plugin/** (SKILL.md 22), .claude/agents/target-verifier.md (114) and the CLAUDE.md line that says the generator needs Context7 until plan 2, and edits site stackgen.md (358, the passive hint, D3)
decisions.rejected: Ask each one; they follow from D1, D3, D4, D11-D13

decisions.decision: Every source fails in the middle of the run (rulings round 2, gap 4)
decisions.ruling: The generator halts with the D11 sentence. It writes no pack and keeps nothing partial; the research record lists the topics that were done, and the next run starts again
decisions.rejected: Keep the finished topics and write a partial pack

decisions.decision: After a mid-run Context7 failure (rulings round 2, gap 5)
decisions.ruling: The official documentation is the primary source for the thin rule for the rest of the run. A topic half researched in Context7 when it failed is researched again from its start with the new sources
decisions.rejected: Keep the half-done Context7 facts for that topic

decisions.decision: Mechanical fixes from rulings round 3 (gaps 1, 2, 3, 6)
decisions.ruling: Gap 1: U2 Verification also accepts the statements of past research evidence of D14. Gap 2: the exact phrase when Context7 is installed binds every new sentence, not only the pack hints: the generator.md replacement, the stack-menu note and the plugin.json description. Gap 3: K1 accepts the stack-menu note and the plugin.json description. Gap 6: the count is 140 lines in 116 files of 48 packs, because plan 1 deletes addon/notion
decisions.rejected: Ask each one

decisions.decision: Context7 has no library or no documents for a technology (rulings round 3, gap 4)
decisions.ruling: That is a thin topic under D13, not a failure. Only a tool error or a timeout is a failure that makes the run switch sources under D12
decisions.rejected: Treat it as a failure and drop Context7 for the run

decisions.decision: Context7 reachable, web sources refused, a thin topic (rulings round 3, gap 5)
decisions.ruling: The generator writes the thin topic from Context7 and discloses it as thin, with the note web sources unreachable. A registry that cannot be read gives the existing reputation UNRESOLVED halt
decisions.rejected: Halt the run on the first thin topic without web sources

decisions.decision: Only one web tool works and no Context7 (rulings round 4, gap 1)
decisions.ruling: WebFetch is the one necessary tool, because it reads the page. Without WebSearch the generator finds the official page through the registry homepage link. Without WebFetch and without Context7 it halts with the D11 sentence
decisions.rejected: Halt when any one web tool is refused

decisions.decision: The research record of D12 and D15 (rulings round 4, gaps 2 and 3)
decisions.ruling: For D12 the switch topic is a note in the component existing .claude/stackgen/citations/<slug>.yaml. For a D15 halt the finished topics are listed in the halt report to the user only; no file is written. The U1 check accepts the D11 sentence (no research source is reachable) and refuses only a halt for lack of Context7 alone
decisions.rejected: A new research-record file

decisions.decision: execute-coder has no web tools (rulings round 4, gap 4)
decisions.ruling: Out of scope. Giving a vwf agent web tools is a separate security decision; parked as docs/memory/gaps/2026-11-09-execute-coder-no-web-tools.md
decisions.rejected: Widen plugins/vwf/agents/execute-coder.md tools in this plan
